stem:
Qasim is completing a mirror image across a fixed vertical symmetry line. Point A is $2$ cm to the left of the line, at a marked height.

Where does the reflected point A' belong?

options.text: A' is the name mirror image for the symmetry line itself.
A' may sit anywhere on the right of the line, at any distance.
A' is $2$ cm to the right of the line, at the same height as A.
First place A', and that placement is what creates the symmetry line.

teacher.key_rationale: Reflection across a fixed line pairs each point with a point the same distance on the other side, at the same height along the line.
